conclusion: The 616.86 hotfix did not improve the observed RDP cadence. The local-console run was substantially faster, but driver, display, and session conditions are confounded; the evidence does not isolate a driver-only cause.

interpretation.steady_metrics: Use independently bound scheduling, GPU, and decode records for qualified counts and native process resources; do not use frontend historical CPU fields as verified native managed CPU.
interpretation.submit_overlap: The summaries cover all emitted records, including warmup, captures, and teardown. The submission expression includes encoder.finish argument evaluation. Overlap is an association, not proof of a dynamic lock or GPU-execution cause.
interpretation.gpu_semantics: GPU callback delivery is CPU-side completion after submit, not hardware scanout or physical-display presentation.
interpretation.scope: All-emitted rows are not steady-state scope. Diagnostic disabled-path remains uninstrumented.
interpretation.focus: Startup focus was cached; the observer was briefly foreground. No whole-run focus proof exists.
interpretation.capture_proof: The three console PNGs are capture-time evidence: scene-ready guard thieving with four food, bank view with 22 food and closing-bank overlay, and return-route 22-food overlay. They do not prove cadence or whole-run focus.
